ns2:section.sectionText: Note: Students must meet the prerequisite of JOUR 400 to enroll in this course. This course is open only to journalism graduate students and juniors and seniors in the News Editorial Journalism and Agricultural Communications majors. Students must register for the lecture and one lab.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
